reasoning: The vulnerability GHSA-qwcr-r2fm-qrc7 affects body-parser versions prior to 1.20.3. In the dependency tree, body-parser is declared as a direct dependency (^1.20.2, resolved to 1.20.2) and is also nested transitively under express@4.18.2 as a pinned 1.20.1 dependency. Simply bumping the direct dependency in package.json will not upgrade the transitive instance pinned under express. Utilizing an npm package override for body-parser to version ^1.20.3 ensures both direct and transitive usages are forced to a patched version (1.20.3) without introducing breaking API changes or requiring an upgrade to express.
